subject: Business Models
title: AI-Powered Marketplaces
description: A quick, practical guide to AI-Powered Marketplaces.

hook.text: Instead of searching 'blue running shoes size 10,' imagine telling AI: 'Find me shoes for trail running under $100.'

buildup.text: AI-powered marketplaces understand intent, not just keywords. The search experience becomes conversational.

discovery.text: AI can match freelancers to projects by analyzing skills, past work, and project requirements automatically.

twist.text: AI matching may reduce choice to one option. If the AI picks your plumber, is it still a marketplace?

climax.text: AI transforms marketplaces from search tools into decision engines. Less browsing, more trusting the algorithm.

punchline.text: Ask the AI, get the match. Searching is becoming obsolete.

quiz.question: How does AI change marketplace search?
options: From keyword matching to intent understanding
